user.title: Add IPTV
user.description: Sign in to your IPTV provider, or add a playlist address.

xtream.title: Provider login
xtream.description: The server address, username and password your provider sent (Xtream Codes; most providers use it).

data_description.name: What the card calls this source. Leave empty for the server's name.
data_description.password: Stays on this Home Assistant: streams are relayed, so it never reaches a browser or a TV.

m3u.title: Playlist
m3u.description: The address of an M3U or M3U8 playlist.

reauth_confirm.title: Provider password
reauth_confirm.description: The provider refused the saved login for {name}. Enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: The server did not answer at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The provider refused the username and password, or the account is not active.
error.no_playlist: No playlist with channels was found at that address.

abort.already_configured: This source is already set up.

data_description.guide_urls: XMLTV addresses, one per line. They fill the channels the provider's guide misses, matched by guide id and then by name. Files over 60 MB are refused.
data_description.players: Leave empty to offer the house's Google Cast devices.
data_description.output: m3u8 plays everywhere, iPhones included; ts only in browsers that run mpegts.js.
data_description.user_agent: Sent to the provider with every request.

play.name: Play
play.description: Play a channel on a TV (a Google Cast device or any player that takes a stream address).

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: The channel's name as the card shows it, or its id.

entry_id.name: Source
entry_id.description: Only look in this entry (when two sources have a channel with the same name).

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Read the channel list again now and download the guide again.

entry_id.name: Source
entry_id.description: Only this entry; every entry when left out.
